mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_config (strategy_id, rebalance_period, max_rebalance_ratio, is_active_rebalance, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{rebalancePeriod}, #{maxRebalanceRatio}, #{isActiveRebalance}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy_config SET rebalance_period = #{rebalancePeriod}, max_rebalance_ratio = #{maxRebalanceRatio}, is_active_rebalance = #{isActiveRebalance}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId}
